mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports_log (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason_id, detail, status, created_at) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reasonId}, #{detail}, 'pending', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT report_id AS reportId, reporter_id AS reporterId, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, reason_id AS reasonId, detail, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM reports_log WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT user_id FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET state = 'deleted' WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE comments SET state = 'deleted' WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE reports_log SET status = 'rejected', resolved_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'post' THEN pb.post_id ELSE c.post_id END AS postId, bd.board_id AS boardId, bd.code AS boardCode, r.reason_id AS reasonId, rs.label AS reasonLabel, r.detail, r.status, r.active_flag AS activeFlag, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.resolved_at AS resolvedAt FROM reports_log r LEFT JOIN posts pb ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = pb.post_id LEFT JOIN comments c ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN posts cp ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND c.post_id = cp.post_id LEFT JOIN boards bd ON bd.board_id = COALESCE(pb.board_id, cp.board_id) LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON r.reason_id = rs.reason_id WHERE COALESCE(pb.user_id, c.user_id) = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports_log r LEFT JOIN posts pb ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = pb.post_id LEFT JOIN comments c ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id WHERE COALESCE(pb.user_id, c.user_id) = #{userId} AND r.resolution_action_id IS NOT NULL
